differences: Readiness is a separate first card above the goal/streak summary, preserving the current app hierarchy.
Unsupported standing hours and unconfigured calorie goals are omitted rather than shown as rings.
Native Health expands the HR chart in place; the adjacent SpO2 card retains its row height.
visual_verdict.reasoning: Visual inspection of the native Overview and Health screenshots confirms clear hierarchy, readable status text, consistent dark surfaces, and working disclosure. This is a qualitative review against the requested layout and observed existing app, not a pixel-match score against an external reference design.
